items.lp_book_number: Adding fractions with the same unit (worked example E0)
items.question_text: Meena's father made some chikki. Meena ate 1/2 of it and her younger brother ate 1/4 of it. How much of the total chikki did Meena and her brother eat together?
items.reason: The sum 1/2 + 1/4 = 3/4 is complete in the question and in the four written steps. A figure that would help but is not needed: one chikki bar of 4 equal pieces, Meena's 2 pieces (1/2 = 2/4) and her brother's 1 piece (1/4) marked, 1 piece left. The book draws this on p.175 (4 strips), and the same final picture is already this concept's kept teaching image M3.S24.T24.C142.IMG1 (never linked), so a second copy would repeat it.
items.text_alternative: Steps in text: 4 equal pieces, Meena 2 pieces, brother 1 piece, 3 pieces = 3/4.

items.lp_book_number: Adding Fractions: how much chikki is left?
items.question_text: Meena ate 1/2 of the chikki and her brother ate 1/4 of it, so together they ate 3/4. How much of the total chikki is remaining?
items.reason: The LP question states what was eaten (1/2 and 1/4, together 3/4), so '1 minus 3/4' can be done from the text. In the book this question follows the 'Total chikki eaten' strip (p.175, picture P25-4), which only repeats the 3/4 already written, and that picture is the kept teaching image M3.S24.T24.C142.IMG1.

content.tick_x_formula: x = 260 + 100 * (k - 1), k = tick index from the left, 1-based

diagram.manim_description: On a plain BG 1920 x 1080 canvas draw one horizontal number line in INK, 3 px stroke, from x = 160 to x = 1760 at y = 560, with an arrowhead at both ends. Draw 15 equal vertical ticks in INK, 3 px stroke, 30 px tall and centred on the line; tick k sits at x = 260 + 100 x (k - 1) for k = 1 to 15, so tick 1 (x = 260) is 0, tick 8 (x = 960) is 1 and tick 15 (x = 1660) is 2, and every gap between neighbouring ticks is 1/7. Write five labels 60 px below the line, left to right: '0' under tick 1 in INK, the stacked fraction 4 over 7 under tick 5 in INK, '1' under tick 8 in INK, the stacked fraction 10 over 7 under tick 11 in ANSWER, '2' under tick 15 in INK; the other ten ticks carry no label. Put a filled dot of radius 9 px on the line at tick 5 in INK and a filled dot of radius 9 px on the line at tick 11 in ANSWER. Above the line draw six semicircular arcs bulging upward in ANSWER, 4 px stroke, each of radius 50 px and one tick gap wide: arc 1 from tick 5 to tick 6, arc 2 from tick 6 to tick 7, arc 3 from tick 7 to tick 8, arc 4 from tick 8 to tick 9, arc 5 from tick 9 to tick 10, arc 6 from tick 10 to tick 11. Centre the caption '+ 6/7' (a plus sign followed by the stacked fraction 6 over 7) in ANSWER at x = 960, 90 px above the top of the arcs. Draw nothing else.
must_not_show: labels on any tick other than 0, 4/7, 1, 10/7 and 2
accuracy_checks: 15 ticks, equal 100 px gaps, 7 gaps per unit: tick k is (k - 1)/7
exactly 6 hops, each exactly one gap wide, first starts at tick 5 and last ends at tick 11
hop 3 ends on tick 8 = 1; the 3 hops after it reach 10/7 = 1 + 3/7
caption + 6/7 agrees with the six hops of 1/7
diagram.alt_text: A number line from 0 to 2 in sevenths with six hops of one seventh from 4/7 to 10/7 and the caption plus 6/7.
